# LawLinq

> > LawLinq is a free California lawyer referral and matching service specializing in personal injury, workers' compensation, and employment law cases throughout Los Angeles County and California.

LawLinq connects consumers with vetted attorneys across California, with particular focus on Los Angeles, Long Beach, and Pasadena. The platform provides settlement calculators, legal guides, and comprehensive resources for personal injury claims, workplace injuries, and employment disputes under California law.
